_comment: Nahuatl texts we lacked (#6559), found on IA with spelling variants after a holdings survey (37 Nahuatl-tagged books, 14 live, mostly codices). check-holdings: all new.

Comprehensive pass (2026-10-11): IA language:nah + subject Nahuatl language/literature + Aztecs, 454 items -> 340 editions after holdings/dupe filter -> printed Nahuatl works 1553-1914 one copy per edition, plus six Filologica/Amoxcalli manuscript image sets. Dropped: held/queued, mis-tagged (Santali Bible, Proust), crank (Denison), non-Nahuatl travel/history, one-image codex uploads.
